title: The Pink and Silver New Year's Eve Party Decor
description: Pink New Year's Eve party decor from Amazon: a pink and silver star balloon arch, pink foil fringe curtains, a pink disco cloud, champagne bottle and glass balloons, a rose gold glitter Happy New Year banner and a silver sequin table runner.
intro: Last New Year's Eve I strung up one sad gold banner at 11:40 pm and called it decor. Never again. This year the kitchen is getting pink foil curtains, a balloon arch with silver starbursts and a mirrored disco cloud that throws pink sparkles all over the cabinets. Giant champagne balloons, because subtle was never the plan. A silver sequin runner on the island, a rose gold banner, done. It goes up in one evening, and my cat already approved it by sitting on the chair.

sections.heading: The backdrop
paragraphs: Two pink metallic foil fringe curtains on the wall, the pink and silver star balloon arch around them and the rose gold glitter Happy New Year banner across the middle.

sections.heading: The sparkly bits
paragraphs: A pink mirrored disco cloud on its chain (12.2 x 6.3 in), the pink champagne bottle and glass balloons (about 38 in and 35 in tall) and a silver sequin table runner (12 x 108 in) down the island.
